page.excerpt: Will bitcoin go back up? Bitcoin trades at about $75,700 on Saturday evening, November 7, 2026 (CoinGecko, 5:30 p.m. ET). That is 2.2% below October's close and 40% below the record of $126,080 set in October 2025. Whether the price recovers by year-end comes down to three levels and a short list of dates: if bitcoin holds the $75,700 cost basis of recent buyers, the road back to $80,000 to $90,00
